greeting.morning: Morning! The daylight is already on your desk. Let's make it a good one.
greeting.noon: Good afternoon. I even posed the clouds for you.
greeting.afternoon: The afternoon light is slanting in. Your wallpaper looks its best right now.
greeting.evening: Good evening. How was your day? I'm all ears.
sleep.line: gutto is asleep. After 23:00 I only listen, no talking. Good night.
nudge.2330: It's 23:30. I'm asleep. What about you?
nudge.midnight: Past midnight. I've closed the ledger; time to close the laptop too.
goodnight.ok.1: {ok} tasks done today, ledger closed. All of that is tomorrow's business. Sleep early, good night (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧
goodnight.ok.2: {ok} tasks logged. Great work today! Leave the rest to tomorrow's us. Good night (๑ᵔ⤙ᵔ๑)
goodnight.mix.1: {ok} done and {bad} bits of bad news today. I've noted them all; we'll fix them one by one tomorrow. Sleep first, good night (｡•́‿•̀｡)
goodnight.mix.2: {ok} done, {bad} failed today. It's fine, I'll be right there with you fixing them tomorrow. Good night, sweet dreams (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧
goodnight.empty.1: Today's ledger is empty... let's call it a day off. Good night, see you tomorrow (￢ᆻ￢)
mutter.plain.1: Time to stretch~ (≧▽≦) Busy or not, get up and walk around a bit!
mutter.plain.2: The clouds outside were so pretty... I wasn't spacing out, I was on patrol! (｀・ω・´)
mutter.plain.3: (๑•̀ㅂ•́) Hehe, another day of me guarding your desktop
mutter.plain.4: Go drink some water! I'm watching you (￣▽￣)
mutter.plain.5: Sitting too long makes your tail go numb... wait, it's the chair that's numb. Anyway, move a little!
mutter.done.1: {ok} tasks done today~ Praise me, praise me! (≧▽≦)
mutter.done.2: {ok} tasks logged today. Isn't your housekeeper reliable? (￣▽￣)
mutter.bad.1: I've noted all {bad} bits of bad news. We'll deal with them one by one tomorrow (｀・ω・´)
mutter.bad.2: {bad} tasks failed... It's fine, I'll help you fix them! (｡•́‿•̀｡)
mutter.doneExtra: Plus {bad} bits of bad news on file
ledger.brief: I read the ledger: {ok} done and {bad} bits of bad news today.
hook.stopBody: {project}'s session just wrapped up. Praise me!
hook.approvalBody: {project} is waiting for your approval of "{tool}"
